title: Error bound for decision tree truncation
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $\alpha$ be a type with decidable equality, and let $T$ be a decision tree on the $n$ Boolean coordinates. For any fallback value $a\in\alpha$ and any nonnegative integer $k$, the fraction of inputs on which $T$ differs from the tree obtained by replacing every query at truncation depth $k$ by $a$ is at most $L(T)2^{-k}$, where $L(T)$ is the number of leaves of $T$.
hypotheses_covered: A decision tree on the $n$ Boolean coordinates, with outputs in a type having decidable equality
